# Nuri

> Nuri combines a passkey-based self-custodial crypto wallet with access to provider-operated card and banking services. This website exposes free public content and read-only tools, plus a separately paid postcard fulfillment API. Public website access does not grant private banking access.

## What Nuri is, in one list

- A crypto wallet built around passkeys and co-signing; recovery depends on the wallet and backup setup
- Self-custody describes the crypto wallet, not a bank account or card balance
- Provider-operated card and banking services have separate terms and eligibility
- Public product information, knowledge guides, editorial notes and support FAQs
- Free unauthenticated website reads and nine public read-only MCP tools
- Separate postcard API: no-mail provider preview and paid real fulfillment, not a payment sandbox
- Website content in English, German, Spanish and Italian; developer reference in English
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/nuri-com/id6754772131)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nuri.mobileios)

## When to use Nuri

Use these public surfaces for concrete, bounded jobs:

- [Compare Bitcoin hardware](https://nuri.com/shop/feed.json): Read GET /shop/feed.json, or call list_shop_products with {} and get_product with a slug returned by that list. These are catalog reads, not purchases.
- [Answer a card or bank FAQ](https://nuri.com/card-support): Read GET /card-support/index.md, or call search_support_faq with {"query":"declined"}. Use get_support_answer with an id from the result for the full answer. These tools read public guidance, not a customer account or support ticket.
- [Read Nuri guides and integration docs](https://nuri.com/knowledge): Read GET /knowledge/index.md for the guide index and follow its links. Request a page with Accept: text/markdown, or call read_public_page_markdown with {"path":"/docs"} for this integration reference. Use tools/list to see the allowed paths.
- [Prepare a postcard integration](https://nuri.com/docs/x402-username-marketplace): Read GET /api/x402 for service details and follow the postcard reference. POST /api/x402/postcards/preview renders without mailing. POST /api/x402/postcards is a separate paid fulfillment endpoint and is not part of the read-only MCP server.

Connect a remote Streamable HTTP client to https://nuri.com/mcp without credentials. Initialize, send notifications/initialized, call tools/list, then tools/call. See the [safe quickstart](https://nuri.com/docs#mcp) for complete curl requests and expected results. Public tools cannot provision an account, issue a card, move funds or read private balances. Do not infer those capabilities from app descriptions.

## Paid agent services

- [x402 service catalog](https://nuri.com/api/x402)
- [Username-routed postcard documentation](https://nuri.com/docs/x402-username-marketplace)
- First paid endpoint: [POST /api/x402/postcards](https://nuri.com/api/x402/postcards) (USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum; actual thanks.io cost + 21%)
- [No-mail preview and payment boundaries](https://nuri.com/docs#postcards): preview requires no payment but calls thanks.io with supplied content. Paid fulfillment uses real funds and physical mail; obtain explicit approval first. Check the live catalog and payment challenge for current terms and availability.

## Compatibility and access

Public read-only website access is free and requires no API key. The existing unversioned website API is v1, identified on public read-only API responses by X-Nuri-API-Version: 1. Existing v1 surfaces are preserved; a future incompatible major version gets a separate path. No sunset is currently scheduled and no fixed deprecation notice period is promised. /api/v1 is not a public website alias. See [versioning policy](https://nuri.com/docs#versions) and [auth boundaries](https://nuri.com/docs#access).

No official published Nuri CLI package is verified here. Use curl or a remote MCP client; do not install a similarly named registry package as a Nuri client.
